MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. Cannot tell

2. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

3. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.205
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.25

4. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 4
   C. 8
   D. 5

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 38
   C. 88
   D. 22

6. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

7. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 40.5

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 30
   C. 46
   D. 120

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

10. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

12. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

13. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

14. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

15. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

16. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

17. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

18. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

19. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

20. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

21. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

22. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 6
   C. 7
   D. 18

23. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 20
   C. 40
   D. 75

24. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

25. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 22
   C. 16
   D. 55

26. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 13
   C. 3
   D. 41

27. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

28. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

29. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 10
   C. 12
   D. 2

30. Solve for x: x + 5 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 11
   D. 6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

33. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

34. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

35. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

36. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

37. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

38. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

39. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

40. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
